C1.worst_defect: The hero lead ends in builder jargon a newcomer can't parse in five seconds: "Every sale lands in your Vendure store once, as a normal order at the till's price" — why 'once' matters and what 'the till's price' means only become clear two cards further down.

C2.worst_defect: The comparison table says the demo sends "anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com" — a different brand's domain with no word on who wcpos is or how it relates to VendurePOS, which makes a first-time visitor wonder who is behind the site.
C2.where: home/desktop/02, 'Live demo or your own store' table, last row (also home/phone/04)

C3.worst_defect: The path asks for nine steps, with permission lists to assemble by hand and a tax-strategy choice to make, and it has a documented gap: a device key's auto-created role "has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder to that role yourself".
C3.where: quick-start/desktop/02 step 4 and the 'Optional: a device key for each till' section (quick-start.txt)

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written for maintainers: "GET /tally/v1/info advertises order.create 1–5 (ADR 0005)", "(#116)", "order.create v5 custom lines". There's no plain-English line about what changed for a store owner beyond a short 'In short' sentence.

C5.worst_defect: Below the hero, the home page is ten identical grey text-only cards, then a table, then a seven-bullet 'Before you start' list. Nothing breaks the run of text, and the refund caveat appears twice (in the table row and in the last bullet).
C5.where: home/desktop/01–02, 'What it does today' cards through 'Before you start'

C6.worst_defect: On phone the hero screenshot shows only the product grid, and its category chips are cut off at "Gif". The cart is hidden behind a 'Cart (3) · €20.09' tab, so the caption "A sale in progress on the live demo till" isn't visibly true.

C7.worst_defect: Mobile LCP is 2.4 s on both / and /docs/quick-start, just under the 2.5 s 'good' line. Lighthouse also flags 52 KiB of unused JavaScript and render-blocking requests on the home page. Everything else is clean: 98/100/100/100, a correct 404 status, llms.txt, sitemap, robots, a good share card and a search API that returns hits.

overall_worst.defect: In the first five seconds the hero sentence explains the product in builder's terms ("lands in your Vendure store once, as a normal order at the till's price"). A visitor who only half knows Vendure gets the mechanism, not the benefit, and has to read the cards to learn why they should care.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/01 and home/phone/01, hero paragraph under 'Point of sale for Vendure'
overall_worst.fix: Make the lead benefit-first, for example: "Sell in person from any browser, even when the internet drops; every sale shows up in your Vendure store as a normal order, never twice." Leave the 'till's price' detail to the 'Paid, fulfilled, at the till's price' card.
